# Gishnu Gears

> Gishnu Gears Private Limited is an ISO 9001:2015 certified industrial gearbox manufacturer in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded in 1995 as M.M Gears (P) Ltd, the company designs and manufactures worm, helical, bevel, aerator and custom-built gearboxes, precision gears and machined components.

Gishnu Gears Private Limited is located at S.F. No. 796, Door No. 3/217K, Avinashi Road, Near Hotel Le Meridian, Neelambur, Coimbatore – 641062, Tamil Nadu, India. It was founded in 1995 as M.M Gears (P) Ltd and has operated as Gishnu Gears since 2011. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified and manufactures in a 50,000 sq. ft facility across three units, with in-house design, gear cutting, gear grinding and inspection. It supplies customers across India and in international markets.

- Official website: https://www.gishnugears.com/
- Phone (sales): +91 99439 17774
- Enquiries and quotations: https://www.gishnugears.com/contact/
- GSTIN: 33AAHCG6311Q1ZD

## Product series

- [GAL-Series: Aluminium worm gearboxes](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/gal-series.html): Lightweight aluminium worm gear reducers from GAL 40 to GAL 150, for clean, compact and weight-sensitive drives.
- [A-Series: Aquaculture aerator gearboxes](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/a-series.html): Paddle-wheel aerator gearboxes for prawn and shrimp culture, in four models from 1 HP to 3 HP.
- [B-Series: Steering bevel gearboxes](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/b-series.html): Bevel gearboxes with a 1:1 ratio for angular power transmission in steering systems and handling equipment.
- [C-Series: Precision-machined housings](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/c-series.html): Housings and machine components, machined to drawing for accurate fit at assembly.
- [G-Series: Worm reduction gearboxes](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/g-series.html): High torque reduction in a compact right-angle gearbox, available in GU and GV types.
- [H-Series: Inline helical geared motors](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/h-series.html): Double and triple reduction inline helical geared motors for slow-speed, high-torque drives.
- [M-Series: Custom-built gearboxes](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/m-series.html): Customised and tailor-made industrial gearboxes and drives, designed around your specification.
- [O-Series: High-precision special gears](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/o-series.html): Special gears and gear spares, cut and finished to tight tolerances for critical applications.
- [Z-Series: Non-standard gearboxes](https://www.gishnugears.com/series/z-series.html): Customised gearboxes engineered for a specific industry application and produced in volume.

## Key product pages

- [Products overview](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/): All nine series with a guide to choosing between them.
- [All models and specifications](https://www.gishnugears.com/all-product.html): Every model with published ratios and motor ratings, plus a series comparison table.
- [Aerator gearboxes](https://www.gishnugears.com/aerator-gearboxes.html): Paddle-wheel aerator gearboxes for aquaculture and wastewater treatment, with specifications and FAQs.
- [A1 aerator gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/a1-aerator-gearbox.html): The A1 is the 1 HP gearbox in our aquaculture range, with a fixed 14.4 ratio for paddle-wheel pond aerators.
- [A3 aerator gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/a3-aerator-gearbox.html): The A3 covers the widest motor range in the series, from 1 to 3 HP, with ratios between 11 and 13.7.
- [A4 aerator gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/a4-aerator-gearbox.html): The A4 is the 2 to 3 HP aerator gearbox, with a fixed 12.6 ratio.
- [GBH 200 aerator gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/gbh-200-aerator-gearbox.html): The GBH 200 is the 3 HP unit of the range, offered with ratios from 11 to 13.7.
- [B0–B07 steering bevel gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/b0-b07-steering-bevel-gearbox.html): A 1:1 bevel gearbox, models B0 to B07, for transmitting steering torque through a change of direction.
- [Precision-machined housings](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/precision-machined-housings.html): Housings for machine components, machined to drawing for accuracy and reliable integration.
- [GU type worm gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/gu-type-worm-gearbox.html): The compact end of the G-Series: GU 162 to 337 worm reduction gearboxes for everyday industrial drives.
- [GV type worm gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/gv-type-worm-gearbox.html): The larger G-Series models: GV 400 to 900 worm reduction gearboxes for heavier duties.
- [GAL 40–150 aluminium worm gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/gal-40-150-aluminium-worm-gearbox.html): An aluminium worm gear reducer covering ratios 5 to 100 and motors from 0.5 to 20 HP.
- [GH 20–80 inline helical geared motor](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/gh-20-80-inline-helical-geared-motor.html): A double or triple reduction inline helical geared motor for slow-speed, high-torque applications.
- [Custom-built gearboxes](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/custom-built-gearboxes.html): Tailor-made industrial gearboxes and drives, engineered from your complete specification.
- [Bevel helical gearbox](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/bevel-helical-gearbox.html): Bevel helical gearboxes built to order within our M-Series custom programme.
- [High-precision special gears](https://www.gishnugears.com/products/high-precision-special-gears.html): Precision transmission gears made to drawing for critical applications and export customers.

## Manufacturing capabilities

- [Infrastructure](https://www.gishnugears.com/infrastructure/): 50,000 sq. ft facility, machinery list and departments.
- Gear cutting: Nimble NOAH 400H, Nidec ST25, Hobbing machine, Horizontal broaching machine
- Gear grinding: Höfler Helix 400, Worm grinding machine
- Machining: CNC turning machine, Thread milling machine
- Inspection and testing: Klingelnberg P40, Accurate Spectra, Brinell hardness tester KB300H, Rockwell hardness tester, Gauges and instruments
